items.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters Revamped
items.description:
A fan edit of the Yugioh Duel Monsters anime aiming to stay far more true to the manga.
This edit cuts out almost all anime exclusive episode/scenes and incorporates 19 episodes from the 1998 yugioh anime (also known as season 0)
